summary: Nav-icons admin customization feature — ALL GREEN backend+frontend. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_nav_config.py (7/7 PASSED, junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/iteration_45_nav_config.xml) — verified admin email login (pescatoridiuomini@outlook.it / Admin1234! returns session_token + role=administrator), GET /api/admin/settings, PUT /api/admin/settings correctly persists and round-trips nav_config (labels, color, colorActive, indicator, nested NavAsset objects with id/kind/mime/filename), and PUBLIC GET /api/settings exposes nav_config for the mobile bottom bar. Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844): admin logged in via email → /admin/nav-icons loaded without crash; whole-bar preview shown at top with Home (lighthouse MCI icon) / Podcast / Meditazioni / Notizie / Palinsesto / Altro; per-item config cards render with label input, two ColorField swatch rows + hex input, indicator ASwitch, and three NavAssetField upload buttons (Icona normale PNG/WebP, Icona attiva PNG/WebP, Animazione Lottie/GIF/WebP animato). Verified: (a) editing testID='label-index' to 'CasaTest18308' updates the top preview cell live, (b) tapping the preview 'Podcast' cell switches the active state (active color pill + indicator dot on top), (c) pressing testID='nav-icons-save' returns the success message 'Personalizzazione salvata ✓ Le modifiche sono già attive nell\'app.', (d) after save, public /api/settings returns nav_config.index.label='CasaTest18308' with no auth, (e) the PUBLIC bottom bar on '/' and '/podcast' displays the new custom Home label with the lighthouse icon, (f) tapping Podcast in the public bottom bar navigates to /podcast, (g) tapping the custom Home label navigates back to /, (h) no red screen, no console errors, bar renders on both stack and tab screens. Test marker cleared via PUT /admin/settings {nav_config:{}} at the end.
critical_code_review_comments: GeneralSettings.nav_config is Optional[Dict[str, Any]] (server.py:2562) — permissive by design, PUT accepts nested NavAsset objects verified by test_nav_config_accepts_asset_shape.
GET /api/settings (server.py:1894) is public and returns nav_config as-is; useNavItems in navConfig.tsx correctly resolves and falls back to catalog defaults when a per-key config is missing.

AppBottomBar.NavItem renderIcon has clean fallback chain: animation → active icon → vector icon (with iconBroken/iconActiveBroken/animBroken state), so a broken uploaded asset cannot break navigation.
Home default icon correctly uses MaterialCommunityIcons 'lighthouse'/'lighthouse-on' (navConfig.tsx:45).

ALLOWED_MEDIA_EXT (server.py:4008-4009) includes gif, webp, json, lottie; _optimize_image (server.py:4035) correctly skips is_animated / n_frames>1 so animated GIF/WebP are NOT flattened — matches the feature spec.
Minor (informational, not a blocker): several 'shadow*'/'textShadow*' deprecation warnings are logged by RN-Web on load (project-wide, not this feature) — safe to ignore for now.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (admin nav-icons load + label edit + preview tap + save + public bottom-bar reflection + navigation regression all verified on 390x844)
